question_sw: SDL ya kampuni yenye mishahara ya TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000 kwa mwezi. Mwajiri analipa TZS 175,000 kwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kiwango cha 3.5% kinatumiwa kwa jumla ya mishahara yote (gross payroll).
question_en: SDL for a company with TZS 5,000,000 monthly payroll is how much?
answer_en: SDL = 3.5% × TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000 per month. The employer pays TZS 175,000 to TRA by the 7th of the following month. The 3.5% rate is applied to total gross payroll.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mgeni anayeishi Tanzania kwa miaka 20 ana haki maalum chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A inategemea URAIA, si muda wa makazi. Mtu anayeishi Tanzania kwa miaka 20 bila kupata uraia wa Tanzania bado anachukuliwa kuwa raia wa kigeni chini ya amri hii. Muda wa makazi haumpi msamaha wowote.
question_en: Does a non-citizen living in Tanzania for 20 years have special rights under GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A is based on CITIZENSHIP, not length of residence. A person who has lived in Tanzania for 20 years without obtaining Tanzanian citizenship is still considered a non-citizen under this order. Length of residence provides no exemption.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Biashara ya kuuza programu za simu (mobile apps) Tanzania — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uuzaji wa programu za simu kwa wateja Tanzania unashughulikiwa kama huduma ya kidijitali na unabeba VAT inayofaa. Kama kampuni imesajiliwa VAT, lazima itoe risiti za EFD na ikusanye VAT. Kwa watoa kutoka nje ya nchi, masharti yanaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: A business selling mobile apps in Tanzania — does VAT apply?
answer_en: Yes. Selling mobile apps to Tanzanian customers is treated as a digital service and carries applicable VAT. If the company is VAT-registered, it must issue EFD receipts and collect VAT. For foreign-based providers, requirements may differ — verify with TRA.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Je, STR inatumika kwa bidhaa za mazao ya bahari (samaki, pweza)?
answer_sw: Bidhaa za mazao ya bahari zinaweza kuwa kwenye Common List, lakini hali inategemea aina maalum ya bidhaa. Samaki safi na bidhaa za bahari zinazozalishwa ndani ya EAC kwa ujumla zinaweza kustahili — lakini thibitisha na ofisi ya forodha kama aina yako mahususi ipo kwenye Common List ya sasa.
question_en: Does STR apply to marine products (fish, octopus)?
answer_en: Marine products may be on the Common List, but eligibility depends on the specific type. Fresh fish and marine products produced within EAC can generally qualify — but verify with the customs office whether your specific type is on the current Common List.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Nina mahindi kutoka Tanzania yanayokwenda Kenya — mahindi yote ya Tanzania yanapata STR?
answer_sw: Lazima masharti mawili yakidhiwe. Kwanza: mahindi lazima yawe kwenye Common List — ndiyo, mahindi kwa ujumla yako. Pili: mahindi lazima yathibitishwe kuzalishwa Tanzania (originating status) kupitia SCO. Kama masharti yote mawili yanakidhiwa na thamani haitazidi USD 2,000, basi unapata manufaa ya STR.
question_en: I have Tanzanian maize going to Kenya — do all Tanzanian maize get STR benefits?
answer_en: Two conditions must both be met. First: maize must be on the Common List — yes, maize is generally on it. Second: maize must be certified as produced in Tanzania (originating status) via an SCO. If both conditions are met and value does not exceed USD 2,000, then you get STR benefits.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: SDL inalipwa pamoja na PAYE au tofauti?
answer_sw: SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinalipwa ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, lakini zinaweza kuwa na malipo tofauti au kwa fomu tofauti kupitia mfumo wa TRA. Kwa vitendo, mara nyingi zinalipwa pamoja kupitia mfumo wa TRA. Hakikisha kila moja inalipwa kwa mstari sahihi wa malipo.
question_en: Is SDL paid together with PAYE or separately?
answer_en: Both SDL and PAYE are due by the 7th of the following month, but they may be separate payments or forms through the TRA system. In practice, they are often paid together through the TRA system. Ensure each is credited to the correct payment line.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Nini lengo la SDL — ni malipo ya likizo ya ugonjwa au mafunzo ya kazi?
answer_sw: Lengo la SDL ni kufadhili mafunzo ya ufundi na ujuzi wa kazi (vocational training) nchini Tanzania — si malipo ya likizo. SDL ilanzishwa ili kusaidia VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na mifumo ya mafunzo ya kitaalamu. Mwajiri ndiye analipa, mfanyakazi hapunguziwa kitu.
question_en: What is the purpose of SDL — is it sick leave payments or job training?
answer_en: The purpose of SDL is to fund vocational and job skills training in Tanzania — not leave payments. SDL was established to support VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and professional training systems. The employer pays it; nothing is deducted from the employee.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: OSHA na WCF — vinahusu usalama wa kazi lakini ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): inasimamia USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi wa mahali pa kazi, mafunzo ya usalama, usajili wa mwajiri wa OSHA. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): inatoa FIDIA ya pesa kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia kazini. OSHA = kuzuia ajali; WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali. Ni taasisi mbili tofauti lakini zinafanya kazi pamoja katika kuzuia na kukabiliana na ajali za kazi.
question_en: OSHA and WCF — both related to workplace safety but what is the difference?
answer_en: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority): oversees WORKPLACE SAFETY — workplace inspections, safety training, employer OSHA registration. WCF (Workers Compensation Fund): provides CASH COMPENSATION to injured workers. OSHA = accident prevention; WCF = paying compensation after an accident. They are two different institutions that work together in preventing and responding to workplace accidents.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or regulatory update

question_sw: Mabenki ya kimataifa yanayofanya kazi Tanzania yako chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. Taasisi za fedha (mabenki, makampuni ya bima) zinasimamia chini ya sheria maalum za sekta ya fedha na Bank of Tanzania (BoT). GN 487A inalenga biashara ndogo na za kati za kila siku — si taasisi za fedha zenye leseni rasmi za BoT au TIRA.
question_en: Do international banks operating in Tanzania fall under GN 487A?
answer_en: No. Financial institutions (banks, insurance companies) are regulated under specific financial sector laws and the Bank of Tanzania (BoT). GN 487A targets everyday small and medium businesses — not financial institutions with formal BoT or TIRA licences.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, mfanyakazi mgeni anahitaji TIN Tanzania kwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kila mtu anayepokea mapato Tanzania — raia au mgeni — anahitaji TIN (Tax Identification Number) ya TRA. TIN inahitajika kwa mwajiri kuwasilisha PAYE returns na kwa mfanyakazi kuwasilisha kodi zake binafsi. Omba TIN kwa mfanyakazi mgeni wako mapema iwezekanavyo baada ya kuanza kazi.
question_en: Does a foreign employee need a Tanzania TIN for PAYE?
answer_en: Yes. Every person receiving income in Tanzania — citizens and foreigners — needs a TRA TIN (Tax Identification Number). The TIN is required for the employer to file PAYE returns and for the employee to file personal taxes. Apply for a TIN for your foreign employee as early as possible after they start work.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Je, visa inafutwa pamoja na faini — au ni hatua ya ziada?
answer_sw: Kufutwa kwa visa ni sehemu ya kawaida ya adhabu — si hatua ya ziada ya hiari. Raia wa kigeni aliyepatikana na hatia ya kukiuka GN 487A anaweza kupoteza visa yake na kulazimishwa kuondoka Tanzania. Faini na kufutwa kwa visa vinafanyika pamoja.
question_en: Is visa revocation part of the penalty, or an optional extra step?
answer_en: Visa revocation is a standard part of the penalty — not an optional additional step. A non-citizen found guilty of violating GN 487A can lose their visa and be required to leave Tanzania. The fine and visa revocation happen together.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Adhabu ya chini kabisa kwa mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A ni ngapi — TZS 500,000 au zaidi?
answer_sw: Faini ya chini kabisa ni TZS 10,000,000 (milioni kumi) — si TZS 500,000 wala TZS 1,000,000. Mbali na faini, mshtakiwa anaweza pia kupata kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 gerezani NA kufutwa kwa visa yake. Ni adhabu kali mno.
question_en: What is the minimum penalty for a non-citizen violating GN 487A — TZS 500,000 or more?
answer_en: The minimum fine is TZS 10,000,000 (ten million) — not TZS 500,000 or TZS 1,000,000. In addition to the fine, the offender may face up to 6 months imprisonment AND visa revocation. The penalties are severe.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Je, kuna adhabu kali zaidi kwa mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A mara ya pili?
answer_sw: Sina uhakika wa masharti maalum ya marudio ya makosa (recidivism) ndani ya GN 487A. Amri inaeleza adhabu za msingi: TZS 10M na hadi miezi 6 gerezani. Kwa hali ya ukiukaji wa mara ya pili, thibitisha na mwanasheria au Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Are there enhanced penalties for a non-citizen violating GN 487A a second time?
answer_en: I am not certain of specific recidivism provisions within GN 487A. The order specifies basic penalties: TZS 10M and up to 6 months imprisonment. For the specific situation of a second violation, verify with a lawyer or the Immigration Services Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) ni nini na inapatikanaje?
answer_sw: SCO (Simplified Certificate of Origin) ni hati inayothibitisha kwamba bidhaa zimezalishwa au kutengenezwa ndani ya nchi wanachama wa EAC/COMESA. Inapatikana kutoka kwa mamlaka za forodha au ofisi za biashara nchini. SCO inahitajika kuonyesha bidhaa zinastahili kupata manufaa ya STR.
question_en: What is the Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) and how do you get one?
answer_en: An SCO (Simplified Certificate of Origin) is a document certifying that goods were produced or processed within an EAC/COMESA member state. It is obtained from customs authorities or trade offices in the country. The SCO is required to show goods qualify for STR benefits.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mfanyabiashara wa mipaka anaweza kupata SCO wapi?
answer_sw: SCO inapatikana kutoka kwa mamlaka za forodha au ofisi za biashara nchini Tanzania. Katika maeneo mengi ya mpakani, kuna ofisi maalum zinazosaidia wafanyabiashara wadogo kupata hati za STR. Thibitisha na ofisi ya forodha ya eneo lako au Ofisi ya Biashara ya Wilaya.
question_en: Where can a border trader get an SCO?
answer_en: The SCO is available from customs authorities or trade offices in Tanzania. In many border areas, there are dedicated offices to help small traders obtain STR documents. Confirm with your local customs office or District Trade Office.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Je, kampuni ya utalii (safari company) ina mfumo maalum wa VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Kampuni za utalii zinaweza kuwa na mfumo maalum wa VAT — hasa kwa huduma za utalii zinazotolewa kwa wageni (inbound tourism). Inaweza kustahili zero-rating kwa baadhi ya huduma. Sina uhakika wa kanuni za sasa maalum. Thibitisha na TRA au Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB).
question_en: Does a safari/tourism company have a special VAT framework in Tanzania?
answer_en: Tourism companies may have a special VAT framework — especially for tourism services provided to foreign visitors (inbound tourism). Some services may qualify for zero-rating. I am not certain of current specific rules. Verify with TRA or Tanzania Tourism Board (TTB).
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or regulatory update

question_sw: Watoto wa raia wa kigeni waliozaliwa Tanzania — GN 487A inawasimamia?
answer_sw: Inategemea hali ya uraia wao. Ikiwa mtoto amepata uraia wa Tanzania, GN 487A haimthiri. Ikiwa mtoto bado ni raia wa kigeni licha ya kuzaliwa Tanzania, GN 487A inatumika. Mshauri wa kisheria anaweza kusaidia kutathmini hali ya uraia wa kila mmoja.
question_en: Children of non-citizens born in Tanzania — does GN 487A apply to them?
answer_en: It depends on their citizenship status. If a child has obtained Tanzanian citizenship, GN 487A does not apply to them. If the child remains a non-citizen despite being born in Tanzania, GN 487A applies. A legal adviser can help assess each person's citizenship status.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Dereva wa bodaboda — ana wajibu gani wa kodi na leseni?
answer_sw: Dereva wa bodaboda kwa kawaida anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya udereva (driving licence) ya kategoria husika; (2) Leseni ya gari (vehicle registration na bima); (3) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri kama ana duka au kituo; (4) TIN na BRELA kama biashara imekua. PAYE haitumiki kwa mwenye biashara yake mwenyewe. VAT kwa kawaida haifiki. Angalia kanuni za halmashauri yako.
question_en: A motorcycle taxi (bodaboda) rider — what tax and licence obligations do they have?
answer_en: A bodaboda rider typically needs: (1) An appropriate driving licence; (2) Vehicle registration and insurance; (3) A business licence from the local council if they have a base or station; (4) TIN and BRELA registration if the business has grown. PAYE does not apply to self-employed operators. VAT typically does not apply. Check your local council's rules.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act or regulatory update

question_sw: STR ililenga kuwasaidia wafanyabiashara gani?
answer_sw: STR ililenga kuwasaidia wafanyabiashara wadogo wa mpakani — hasa wanawake wanaouza mazao, vyakula, na bidhaa ndogo ndogo kati ya nchi za EAC na COMESA. Biashara kubwa na makampuni makubwa yanayoagiza bidhaa kwa wingi bado yanatumia utaratibu wa kawaida wa forodha.
question_en: Who does STR aim to help?
answer_en: STR was designed to help small border traders — especially women selling produce, food, and small goods between EAC and COMESA countries. Large businesses and companies importing goods in large quantities still use the standard customs process.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Mwajiri anayetoa mshahara wa mgeni — anaweza kuficha mshahara fulani kutoka PAYE?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mwajiri anahitaji kujumuisha MAPATO YOTE ya ajira — mshahara wa msingi, posho, manufaa, na malipo mengine — kwenye hesabu ya PAYE. Kuficha sehemu ya mshahara au manufaa TRA ni ukiukaji wa sheria ya PAYE na unaweza kusababisha adhabu na deni la PAYE.
question_en: An employer paying a foreign employee — can they hide part of the salary from PAYE?
answer_en: No. The employer must include ALL employment income — basic salary, allowances, benefits, and other payments — in the PAYE calculation. Concealing part of the salary or benefits from TRA is a violation of PAYE law and can result in penalties and PAYE arrears.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Simplified Customs Document (SCD) ni rahisi kiasi gani?
answer_sw: SCD ni fomu rahisi ya forodha iliyoundwa maalum kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo wa STR. Ina sehemu chache zaidi na lugha rahisi zaidi kuliko fomu ya kawaida ya forodha. Lengo lake ni kupunguza ugumu wa karatasi kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo ambao wengi hawana elimu ya juu ya biashara.
question_en: How simplified is the Simplified Customs Document (SCD)?
answer_en: The SCD is a simplified customs form designed specifically for small STR traders. It has fewer sections and simpler language than the standard customs form. Its purpose is to reduce paperwork complexity for small traders, many of whom may not have advanced business education.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Je, PAYE inategemea ni wapi kazi inafanywa au ni wapi mshahara unalipwa?
answer_sw: PAYE Tanzania inategemea MAHALI PA KAZI — si mahali pa malipo ya mshahara. Kama mtu anafanya kazi Tanzania, PAYE Tanzania inatumika hata kama mshahara unalipwa Hong Kong, London, au mahali pengine. Mahali pa malipo ya mshahara si kigezo cha msingi — mahali pa kazi ndio msingi.
question_en: Does PAYE depend on where work is performed or where salary is paid?
answer_en: Tanzania PAYE depends on WHERE WORK IS PERFORMED — not where the salary is paid. If a person works in Tanzania, Tanzania PAYE applies even if salary is paid in Hong Kong, London, or elsewhere. The place of salary payment is not the primary criterion — the place of work is the basis.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing PAYE bands or non-resident tax treatment

question_sw: Biashara ya usafirishaji wa Uber/Bolt Tanzania — VAT inatumika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Huduma za usafirishaji wa kidijitali kama Uber na Bolt zinachukuliwa kama huduma za biashara zinazostahili VAT Tanzania. Kama mtoaji wa huduma amefika kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6), lazima asajiliwe na ikusanye VAT. Hata hivyo, masharti maalum ya makampuni ya kidijitali ya kimataifa yanategemea muundo wao wa biashara Tanzania.
question_en: Ride-hailing business like Uber/Bolt in Tanzania — does VAT apply?
answer_en: Yes. Digital transport services like Uber and Bolt are treated as business services subject to Tanzania VAT. If the service provider has reached the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months), they must register and collect VAT. However, specific requirements for international digital companies depend on their Tanzania business structure.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or CG notice on digital VAT implementation

question_sw: Je, GN 487A inazuia raia wa kigeni KUISHI Tanzania au KUFANYA BIASHARA?
answer_sw: GN 487A inazuia AINA za biashara — si makazi. Raia wa kigeni ana haki ya kuomba kibali cha makazi na kukaa Tanzania vizuri. GN 487A inasema tu kwamba mkazi huyo mgeni hawezi KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA mojawapo ya shughuli 15 maalum zilizokatazwa.
question_en: Does GN 487A prohibit non-citizens from LIVING in Tanzania or from DOING BUSINESS?
answer_en: GN 487A restricts TYPES of business activity — not residency. A non-citizen has the right to apply for a residence permit and live in Tanzania lawfully. GN 487A only says that the foreign resident cannot OWN or OPERATE one of the 15 specific prohibited activities.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Serikali ya Tanzania inalipa SDL kwa wafanyakazi wake?
answer_sw: Idara za serikali kwa kawaida haziko chini ya SDL kama ilivyo kwa waajiri wa sekta binafsi. Hata hivyo, mashirika ya umma (parastatals) yanayofanya kazi kwa hali ya kampuni yanaweza kuwa na wajibu tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA hali halisi ya aina ya shirika lako.
question_en: Does the Tanzanian government pay SDL for its employees?
answer_en: Government departments are typically not subject to SDL in the same way as private sector employers. However, public corporations (parastatals) operating in a corporate structure may have different obligations. Verify with TRA the exact situation for your type of organization.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kupinga uamuzi wa TRA wa kukataa refund yangu?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kama TRA imekataa madai yako ya VAT refund, una haki ya kupinga uamuzi huo. Njia za kawaida za kupinga ni: (1) Omba ukaguzi wa ndani wa TRA; (2) Lalamika kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA; (3) Fika TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) ikiwa bado hujaridhika. Fuata hatua za kisheria kwa mpangilio na muda unaohusika.
question_en: Can I challenge TRA's decision to reject my refund?
answer_en: Yes. If TRA has rejected your VAT refund claim, you have the right to challenge that decision. The standard challenge paths are: (1) Request an internal TRA review; (2) Appeal to the TRA Commissioner General; (3) Go to TRAB (Tax Revenue Appeals Board) if still unsatisfied. Follow the legal steps in order and within applicable timeframes.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Kampuni ya EPZ (Export Processing Zone) inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Makampuni ya EPZ kawaida yana msamaha au vivutio maalum vya kodi ikiwemo SDL. Hata hivyo, masharti mahususi yanategemea mikataba ya TIC/EPZ ya kila kampuni. Thibitisha na TRA au TIC ili kujua hali halisi ya kampuni yako.
question_en: Does an EPZ (Export Processing Zone) company pay SDL?
answer_en: EPZ companies typically have exemptions or special tax incentives that may include SDL. However, specific terms depend on each company's TIC/EPZ agreement. Verify with TRA or TIC to confirm your company's specific situation.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: STR ina zana gani kuu 4 za biashara?
answer_sw: STR ina zana 4 kuu: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — hati inayothibitisha asili ya bidhaa; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — fomu rahisi ya forodha badala ya fomu ngumu; (3) Common List — orodha ya bidhaa ~370 zinazostahili STR; (4) Kizingiti cha USD 2,000 — mipaka ya thamani ya msafara.
question_en: What are the 4 main STR instruments?
answer_en: STR has 4 main instruments: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — a document certifying the origin of goods; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — a simplified customs form instead of complex forms; (3) Common List — list of ~370 eligible goods; (4) USD 2,000 threshold — the consignment value limit.
next_review_trigger: EAC/COMESA Common List revision or threshold amendment

question_sw: Je, TRA inaweza kufanya ukaguzi (audit) wakati wa kushughulikia refund ya VAT?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Madai ya VAT refund mara nyingi husababisha ukaguzi wa TRA. Hii ni kawaida na inatarajiwa — si adhabu. TRA inataka kuhakikisha madai ni halali kabla ya kutoa pesa. Kuwa tayari kuwasilisha hati zote, kumbukumbu za ununuzi/mauzo, na majibu ya maswali ya ukaguzi.
question_en: Can TRA conduct an audit when processing a VAT refund?
answer_en: Yes. VAT refund claims often trigger a TRA audit. This is normal and expected — not a punishment. TRA wants to ensure claims are legitimate before releasing money. Be prepared to provide all documents, purchase/sales records, and answers to audit questions.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuepuka matatizo ya ukaguzi wa VAT wakati wa kudai refund?
answer_sw: Kuepuka matatizo ya ukaguzi wa VAT: (1) Hifadhi kumbukumbu zote za VAT kwa miaka 5 angalau; (2) Hakikisha risiti zote za EFD zimewekwa vizuri; (3) Oanisha VAT returns na kumbukumbu za uhasibu; (4) Nunua kutoka wasambazaji waliosajilistwaa VAT tu; (5) Epuka madai ya input VAT yasiyohusiana na biashara; (6) Wasilisha VAT returns kwa wakati na kwa usahihi. Kumbukumbu nzuri = ukaguzi rahisi.
question_en: How to avoid audit problems when claiming a VAT refund?
answer_en: To avoid VAT audit problems: (1) Keep all VAT records for at least 5 years; (2) Ensure all EFD receipts are properly filed; (3) Reconcile VAT returns with accounting records; (4) Buy only from VAT-registered suppliers; (5) Avoid input VAT claims unrelated to business; (6) File VAT returns on time and accurately. Good records = easier audit.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update
